class.name: GradientTexture1D
class.brief_description: A 1D texture that uses colors obtained from a [Gradient].
class.description: A 1D texture that obtains colors from a [Gradient] to fill the texture data. The texture is filled by sampling the gradient for each pixel. Therefore, the texture does not necessarily represent an exact copy of the gradient, as it may miss some colors if there are not enough pixels. See also [GradientTexture2D], [CurveTexture] and [CurveXYZTexture].

members.member: The [Gradient] used to fill the texture.
The number of color samples that will be obtained from the [Gradient].
